newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu promises statement after legal decision.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu promises statement after legal decision.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will make a televised statement on Sunday after the Justice Ministry announces at 1530 GMT whether he will be indicted in a corruption scandal, his office said.

A spokeswoman said he would speak from his office to Israel's Channel One and Channel Two stations. "There will be a statement after the announcement," she told Reuters without giving a specific time.
